translations.web: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear, and the mute speak!”
translations.bsb: The people were utterly astonished and said, “He has done all things well! He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”
translations.kjv: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
translations.asv: And they were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well; he maketh even the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
